semiconductor_relevance: High — Kolink specializes in thermal solutions critical for semiconductor applications, particularly in heat management.
summary: Kolink International Corp. is a thermal solutions expert that provides high-performance heat sinks and customized thermal modules essential for semiconductor testing and other applications. With over 25 years of experience, they focus on innovative research and development to meet the thermal demands of various industries.

regional_presence.Taiwan: Kolink has a strong manufacturing presence in Taiwan, leveraging advanced production equipment and a professional R&D team.
